_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-vref-pvt-pex on the `klt sim`
harness (issue #278). The per-experiment half of the adapter contract:
sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file.
Claim: Through the SAME co-simulated closed-loop topology sim/closed-loop-vref-pvt uses (bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup, wired exactly as design/bandgap_top.sch specifies), vref's DC operating-point value across the full PVT grid, confirmed settled and at a genuine closed-loop operating point (startup released, loop closed, fb not railed -- the four criteria sim/lib/pvt_verdict_common.sh's pvt_closed_loop_verdict encodes, applied per point by sim/harness/enrich_pvt_report.py) -- with every MOS/resistor device's geometry and every wire parasitic taken from #272's trim-bearing re-extraction of the routed, ASSEMBLED layout/bandgap_top.gds (255 rppd ladder units realising trim code 128 as mask metal) instead of the schematic's as-drawn defaults. This is post-layout (PEX) evidence for the post-layout-simulation bar -- see this directory's README.md for exactly what is and is not extracted/modelled. NOT a claim against any ratified spec row; also computes an INFORMAL temperature coefficient (endpoint method, the -tc.csv companion).
Netlist provenance: layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.pex.spice (#272's trim-bearing re-extraction) + design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice, design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice (the top netlist's three subckts, flattened through its own Xx1/Xx2/Xx3 instance lines by sim/tools/gen_pex_netlist_body.py --cell top -- the DUT body is generated, never hand-transcribed. Bipolar devices are still schematic-sourced; the rppd/rhigh resistors, MOS geometry and every wire parasitic are extracted.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
